cw_polity_wait: You can change government in %1$d turns.
cw_log_peace_over: The peace is over. Wars can begin!
cw_barracks_info: Barracks: %1$d / %2$d soldier slots used. Build more barracks for a bigger army.
cw_no_spy: Build a spy network to see enemy strength.
cw_market_desc: Sell %1$d resources for %2$d gold, or buy %3$d resources for %4$d gold.
cw_n_barracks: Not enough barracks space. Build more barracks.
cw_n_peace: No wars during the first %1$d turns.
cw_n_cooldown: You can't change that right now.
game_forest_desc: Survive endless monster waves! Attacks are automatic: move, collect crystals, level up and defeat the boss of each map.
fg_locked: Clear the previous map to unlock
fg_how_to: Move with the left stick. Attacks are automatic. Collect crystals to level up and choose upgrades. Survive and defeat the boss at 4:30!
fg_w_bolt_desc: Fires at the nearest enemies. More bolts and piercing at higher levels.
fg_w_blades_desc: Blades orbit around you and cut enemies. +1 blade per level.
fg_w_lightning_desc: Strikes random enemies nearby with heavy damage. More strikes per level.
fg_w_thorns_desc: Constantly damages enemies around you. Bigger area per level.
fg_w_arrows_desc: Shoots a fan of arrows where you walk. More arrows per level.
fg_w_frost_desc: An icy wave damages and slows nearby enemies. Larger wave per level.
fg_p_vitality_desc: +20 max health and health regeneration per level.
fg_p_magnet_desc: Pick up crystals from 40% farther per level.
fg_e_bolt_desc: Huge lances pierce every enemy in their path. 5 lances, much faster.
fg_e_blades_desc: 8 blades spin fast and sweep in and out around you.
fg_e_thorns_desc: A larger thorn field that heals you with every hit.
fg_e_arrows_desc: 12 piercing arrows fly in every direction.
